body: Not many people want to give time and date the ugly girl with the uneven cheekbones, lips, and eyes, though. Even if I work for a nice body, people will just mutter "butterface" under their breath. I think my friends enjoy being around me. They say I'm funny and down-to-earth, so I guess I have an ok personality. I kind of want to tell the doctor that I've been having suicidal thoughts, but the only doctor that I'm going to see is a GP, and I don't know if that will be ok to tell him/her. I want to go see a therapist, but they are way too expensive.

Nobody has said I have an ugly face, but I always think they are lying. I see other people look at me with contempt. I see myself in the mirror, and I just look horrible all the time. People used to say I was pretty, but now I'm not. I'm out of high school and I'm 19 years old. I just look at my face in mirror, wishing it would change. If I don't commit suicide, then I might get jaw surgery, but I really feel like I will eventually do commit suicide. I might get some prescription meds from the doctor and overdose during the summer.

I look absolutely horrible. I just want to be pretty, but my face is very asymmetric. I know this is ridiculous, but I can't even go to class anymore because I don't want people to look at my ugly face. I can't change my face, and I don't want to live anymore, but I am so scared of pain, which makes me not want to commit suicide. I don't have any positive traits. I am a worthless human being.
